rules.enforced_by: Pydantic models with frozen=True and extra="forbid"; a state catalog whose members carry their own allowable next states
rules.title: Typed, validated domain model (validation-first)

rules.enforced_by: every external interface read from the environment; model selection is provider-prefixed (provider:model), never a branch in code
rules.title: Configuration discipline (env-driven, nothing hardcoded)

rules.enforced_by: one append-only event stream with a closed, scalar payload catalog and a single registered backend per process
rules.title: The event stream as the single source of truth

rules.enforced_by: a LangGraph interrupt that suspends the run; no outbound message and no durable artefact without an explicit human confirmation
rules.title: Human-in-the-loop for anything with consequences

rules.enforced_by: capability-scoped toolsets with a per-agent tool budget checked by a test, a cross-provider fallback tier, and a deterministic last-resort code path
rules.title: Agent reliability — scoped capabilities & deterministic fallback

rules.enforced_by: pydantic-ai TestModel / FunctionModel bound in place of any provider, in-memory stores for every external interface, and per-test isolation of the event stream
rules.title: Hermetic, reproducible tests

rules.enforced_by: append-only ADRs taking the next free number, plus a drift test that fails when the generated overview goes stale
rules.title: Append-only decision records & accumulative knowledge

rules.enforced_by: durable state in the shared backend only; the engine reads and writes logical paths and a separate layer owns cloud mirroring
rules.title: Durable state in the shared backend; the host is disposable

rules.enforced_by: an observable running version, SemVer with stated triggers, conventional commits, and a pre-push grep for hardcoded models, endpoints and local paths
rules.title: Release, versioning & change hygiene

rules.enforced_by: no blanket except, explicit key access over silent defaults, no mutable defaults, and one stated timezone convention
rules.title: Code style & safety defaults

rules.enforced_by: reviewed feature branches only, with binding shared context in version-controlled rule files rather than per-developer tool settings
rules.title: Collaboration
